Bartender Informant

Mook · Bartender

Hears everything — he has enhanced hearing. For 50 eb, neighborhood gossip; for 200, names.

Tactics: Ducks behind the bar and calls the bouncer.

HP 35 · Seriously Wounded 18 · Death Save 5
